title: Open Complete Freedom & Eligible Saver Accounts, spend $50 within 15 Days, Get $50 Bonus @ Bank of Melbourne
body:
Deal: Open Complete Freedom & Eligible Saver Accounts, spend $50 within 15 Days, Get $50 Bonus @ Bank of Melbourne

[Merlict] I get an error with the online signup asking me to go in to a branch.. really CBF.
[NotReallyaMoneySaver] Lol I had the exact same issue with BankSA or Bank of Melbourne. I live in NSW so I just went to a Westpac branch and they managed to do it for me which was nice!
[NotReallyaMoneySaver] This offer sucks bruh compared to the original one
[artcvan] FYI if you currently hold the St.George / BankSA equivalents, you will not be eligible for this as Bank of Melbourne, BankSA and St.G all share the same system and therefore, for whatever reason, holding an account with one of those banks is your details for all 3 of those banks in total. You can even use the mobile apps and internet banking for all 3 banks using the details for one of them
Learnt this after signing up for St.George and attempting to open BankSA and Bank of Melbourne since they were running the same promo. Got an error out saying I had my details in their systems already and then discovered I could log into Bank of Melbourne using my St.G details
Great job Westpac…
[NotReallyaMoneySaver] It worked for me for BankSA and St George. But that was for the deposit $50, get $50 so YMMV
[artcvan] BankSA and Bank of Melbourne just refused to say I was a new customer, despite being a new customer. It kept erroring out and told me to go to a branch (which I absolutely despise and want to avoid as much as possible) and then I discovered the whole situation with the shared systems across all 3 banks.
Unsure how you got it to work then cause I don't see a solution where it would work. Unless you're able to just open a Complete Freedom + whatever savings account they need, so long as you're signed into the correct Internet Banking front-end, and then that would work?
Also curious to know but are your CANs (customer access number) different with BankSA and St George? If they're the same then I suppose the above would be valid but unsure
[NotReallyaMoneySaver] I believe it's the same CAN. I did go to a branch (St George) to get it done so it ended up being fine. Worked for Bank of Melbourne too but I was too late in depositing the money so I didn't get it.
[artcvan] @NotReallyaMoneySaver: Might try using my CAN to log into Bank of Melbourne and BankSA and ask them tomorrow if I'm able to open accounts for each bank to take advantage of this
Hypothetically would be a "different bank" anyway so?
[VladImpaler] Start on the relevant bank site and when you are directed to provide details instead login using your existing bank info. I had 1 open account and did this with the other 2 banks a few months ago and got the $50 promo deals for both. All of the accounts just showed as Complete Freedom in the same app.
There was no new CAN, everything is via whatever details you have with your current bank.
[artcvan] @VladImpaler: Will give that a shot then, appreciate you saying this! I guess then that's a total of $300 from Westpac Group then… lovely…
[Ryk] They are the same bank.
At one point, years ago, I had a STG account linked to a BSA card
[M00Cow] good thing is if you have kids, if you can get 5.15% if you add to the balance every month.
[artcvan] Plus they also will get $50 with just a deposit, no spending required
Same deal applies at all Westpac Group brands (the deposit $50, get $50, that is)
